stops.name: Grabenstätter Moos
stops.detail: In the early morning, the fog in the Grabenstätter Moos has almost absorbed the reeds and the gnarled willows.

stops.name: Hirschau Bay
stops.detail: The Hirschau Bay was quite a bustling swimming area in the 1970s.

stops.name: wooden observation tower in the Hirschauer Bucht
stops.detail: In preparation for a multimedia lecture, he stands on the wooden observation tower in the Hirschauer Bucht this morning and holds the fluffy microphone into the fog.

stops.name: Achen Delta
stops.detail: The lake shore is lined with thick tree trunks, which the Tyrolean Achen brought with them from the mountains when the last snow melted and piled up like Mikado sticks here in the Achen Delta.
